title: Scalar cokernel classes agree on presentation-cover overlaps
statement: Let T be a commutative totally disconnected topological ring in universe u, X a scheme, M a module over p_X^*C(-,T), and C a pro-etale covering of X. On each member choose a finite free presentation f_i with an isomorphism from the pullback of M to coker f_i. Define its scalar fibre class using the canonical continuous matrix. For points v in C_i and w in C_j with the same image in X, these scalar fibre classes are equal. No Noetherianity, field structure on T or torsion-freeness is assumed.

source.place: Example 3.1; parent comparison proof steps 2--5; for local Smith, Theorem 6.12(2) pivot/division argument.

proof.text: Lift v and w to a point of the fibre product over X, and take an algebraic closure of its residue field. This gives two maps from a common geometric point with equal composites to X.

Pull both presentations to this geometric point using the canonical coefficient comparisons. Evaluation at its final pro-etale object preserves cokernels because every covering splits. The canonical continuous realization identifies the regular coefficient module with T; naturality of its adjoint identifies each pulled-back regular endomorphism with its continuous value at the given point. Finite biproduct coordinates identify both evaluated presentations with the displayed scalar matrices.

The two evaluated cokernels are isomorphic to the same evaluation of M. Transport through the finite-coordinate quotient identifications to obtain an isomorphism of the scalar quotient modules, hence equality of their skeleton classes. Empty members and zero-sized presentations require no exception.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof of the corresponding part of lem-sfb-integral-lfp-constant-model-comparison; explicit universe-polymorphic coefficient construction.

theorem presentationFiberType_eq
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [TopologicalSpace T] [IsTopologicalRing T]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace T] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (baseCoeff T X))
    (C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (n m : C.I₀ → ℕ)
    (f : ∀ i, Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f i)).obj
      (baseCoeff T X)) (m i) ⟶
      Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f i)).obj
      (baseCoeff T X)) (n i))
    (e : ∀ i, Nonempty (pulledMod T (C.f i) M ≅
        cokernel (f i)))
    (i j : C.I₀) (v : C.X i) (w : C.X j) (h : C.f i v = C.f j w) :
    presentationFiberType T (C.f i) (f i) v =
      presentationFiberType T (C.f j) (f j) w
